verdict.rationale: Stable documents locations across multiple US jurisdictions. CMRA locations use IATA-style codes (e.g. SFO1), registered agent locations use 2-letter state codes (e.g. WY, DE), and it markets a 'nationwide' registered agent service. There is no evidence of a browsable location catalog or of per-location capability details shown before signup. The only listing endpoint returns locations already associated with your account. Missing for 10: a pre-signup location directory showing each location's capabilities, international (multi-country) locations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of network breadth.

support.subject: As a digital nomad, I can pick from a broad network of locations — multiple states and countries — and see each location's capabilities before signing up
